label: rem:vc-as-depth-2-instance
title: Volume Conjecture as the depth-2 instance of GS $\leftrightarrow$ period correspondence
html:
Remark (Volume Conjecture as the depth-2 instance of the GS \leftrightarrow period correspondence).

The Kashaev–Murakami–Murakami volume conjecture (conj:kashaev-volume-conjecture) admits a clean structural reading inside the graded-Mikusiński framework (conj:gb-depth-period-correspondence): it is the depth-2 case.

One-line statement

  \text{Volume Conjecture} \;\;\Longleftrightarrow\;\;
  \tau_{\mathrm{arch}}\!\left( G^{(2)}(\mathcal{H}_q) \right)
  \;\xrightarrow{\;\;}\;
  \mathcal{P}_2 \big/ \mathcal{P}_1
  \;=\; \{\text{hyperbolic 3-manifold volumes}\}.

Justification of the reading

The Volume Conjecture asserts that the asymptotic growth of the coloured Jones polynomial J_K^{(N)}(q) at q = e^{2\pi i / N} as N \to \infty equals \mathrm{Vol}(S^3 \setminus K). The algebraic side (J_K \in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]) is field-polymorphic and lives in the substrate (rem:algebraic-core-survives). The geometric side is a real number, transcendental in general.

In graded-Mikusiński terms:

  • J_K^{(N)} is built by repeated application of the depth-2 grouplike \mathrm{Li}_2^q (Faddeev–Kashaev quantum-dilogarithm decomposition).
  • The asymptotic limit at q = e^{2\pi i / N}, N \to \infty, is the archimedean realization \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} followed by std-part on the surreal envelope.
  • Single-\mathrm{Li}_2 factor \Rightarrow iterated-integral depth 2 \Rightarrow Goncharov period-class \mathcal{P}_2 / \mathcal{P}_1 (Bloch regulator K_3^{\mathrm{ind}}(\overline{\mathbb{Q}}) \otimes \mathbb{Q} \to \mathbb{R} / \pi^2 \mathbb{Q}).

The Volume Conjecture is therefore not a coincidence: hyperbolic volumes appear at depth 2 because that is structurally where the Bloch–Wigner regulator lives. Predicted at every depth n is an analogous statement: colored quantum invariants built from \mathrm{Li}_n^q asymptote to weight-n Goncharov periods.

Implications of accepting the depth correspondence

The depth correspondence does not prove the Volume Conjecture. What it does is reduce the conjecture to two structurally smaller claims:

  1. Categorical Laplace transport. Show that the asymptotic at roots of unity coincides with the categorical Laplace transform of \Phi_q followed by std-part — i.e. that the limiting procedure is intrinsically the Mikusiński transform applied stratum-by-stratum. Already partially in the paper via prop:categorical-laplace-unique.
  2. Sharpness at depth 2. Show that the image of G^{(2)} in \mathcal{P}_2 / \mathcal{P}_1 contains the Bloch–Wigner regulator class of every hyperbolic knot complement. This is the modern formulation of Bloch's 1978 conjecture and is a known target in motivic cohomology.

The framework thus does not eliminate the open problem — it places it in its correct depth-graded category, where partial results already exist (Murakami–Murakami 2001 for the figure-8; Garoufalidis–Lê for torus knots; many others).

Cross-reference

For an explicit depth-2 canonical witness on the figure-8 knot embedded in Bring's genus-4 surface, see conj:bring-figure-eight-depth-2-witness. The 50-digit value 2\,\mathrm{Cl}_2(\pi/3) \approx 2.02988\ldots is the Bloch regulator class incarnated as a hyperbolic volume.
